label: Alpine Contributor Table
description: Alpine contributor table — friendly mobile-marketing card: a ranked multi-column table (rank · avatar · name + arbitrary right-aligned value columns), icon + title header, top-N accent wash, count-up values. Alpine-light by default; the FFmpeg Weekly Pulse uses preset:"dark".

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: Table rows. Each: name, optional rank + avatar, and values[] index-aligned to columns.

columns.label: Columns
columns.description: Value-column headers (index-aligned to each row's values).

preset.label: Preset
preset.description: Alpine theme variant (light default; dark = the FFmpeg hero look).

showHeader.label: Show header
showHeader.description: Show the icon + title + subtitle band (default true). False when a parent chrome supplies the title.

topTint.label: Top tint rows
topTint.description: How many top rows get the accent wash (default 3).

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: Accent color (icon chip + top-row wash). Defaults to the theme primary.

backgroundColor.label: Card color
backgroundColor.description: Card surface color. "black@0" → transparent (composed under a chrome).

washColor.label: Wash base
washColor.description: Solid color the row washes blend against (for transparent surfaces composed on a colored backdrop).

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: "premium" (default): rows cascade in via alpha fade — a geq per faded source. "light": the same cascade via free enable-gate pops — no geq, composable, cheap when nested.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

anim.countUp.label: Count up
anim.countUp.description: Count the value columns up during the intro.

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the alpine preset by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit color props still win.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: Named header glyph (shared alpine catalog). A derived HUMAN view of the raw iconPath agent prop: picking a name WRITES the SVG path into iconPath (the stored, code-friendly value); a bespoke agent-written path shows as no selection.

iconPath.label: Icon path (SVG d)
iconPath.description: Header glyph SVG path d (24×24), drawn as a mask on the icon chip — the raw value behind the friendly `icon` knob.

columnColors.label: Column colors
columnColors.description: Per-column value color (index-aligned to columns). Portrait layout tints secondary metrics (e.g. additions green / deletions red).

columnSigns.label: Column signs
columnSigns.description: Per-column sign prefix (index-aligned to columns), e.g. + / -. Portrait only.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only layout contract view: renders the contract wireframe instead of the table — rows GREEN with the measured rule when every row/card is the same size, offenders RED when not. Deterministic default false; production never sets it.
